text:
The water of South

West Bay is bluer

than the sky


but your eyes are

bluer than

South West Bay


And in the caves of

(...)

May rains

have already arrived,


the red malinches

have bloomed again


And the road to

Diriá is cheerful

full of puddles;


but you are no longer

with me

translation.title: Corn Island
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the Caribbean place names, the ellipsis, and the final absence after the rains return.
